I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**, a Tier 2 support escalation for Tansleigh Packaging. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing when scanning the BOL barcode.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2025-07-02. In that conversation he first called the account "TP," which got mixed up with Tansley Parcel, and then confirmed the ticket belongs to Tansleigh Packaging. Hollis is in #central-team and a ticket number isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the channel.
